description: Check whether a Strapi reference is real in the project. Returns valid | unknown (+ didYouMean) | external: a plugin DevKit cannot verify — not installed, not read completely (code that only runs in Strapi), rewritten at boot by the project, registered by a helper DevKit cannot follow, or still being read just after startup; project_info says which and why. Installed plugins DevKit reads completely are checked like your own code. Names are checked as Strapi registers them (an API file `hasAccess.js` is `has-access`; a plugin artifact is the key its index exports). `kind` checks one kind only — the verdict list_broken_refs and the editor use. Call this before writing a magic string.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

kind.description: Check the ref as this kind only (`method`: the service/controller a handler or a method call goes through).

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

ref.description: A Strapi reference: a content-type or component UID (api::article.article, shared.seo), a service / controller / policy / middleware ref (api::article.article, plugin::users-permissions.user, global::is-owner), or a route handler (api::article.article.find). `ref#method` targets one method.

name: validate_reference
title: Validate a Strapi reference
